messages:
maria: taking over the shift conduit 14:00-22:00 PT — I'm primary for the window. passing the baton to aj at 21:50 for the warm handover. quick notes below, pls read before swap.
aj: ack, i'll be on standby from 21:30. send any unresolved p99 alerts my way.
sam: heads-up — KV cache evictions spike on model-alpha around 18:30 historically. watch the kvcache-latency dashboard.
maria: good call. i'll run a KV-warm probe at 17:50 and pre-warm shards if we see >50% miss rate. command I use: `./tools/kvcache_probe --env prod --shard all --warm`
lia: tagging runbooks and short remediation bullets here: 1) kvcache thrash -> run `./scripts/evict-cold && ./scripts/prewarm` then monitor `kvcache/miss-rate` 2) model OOM -> rollback to quantized-0.9 variant in console (route -> model-variants -> pin) 3) latency storm -> flip to burst-capacity pool for affected customer tier.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: [PAGER-3142] high p99 latency for /v1/generate across us-west-2 — triggered at 2025-09-22T18:03:12Z — assigned to eng-oncall.
maria: saw incident-bot, jump-in checklist: a) identify customer impact (are requests 5xx or 200 slow?) b) check model queues and kvmiss c) if user-facing errors, apply routing fallback to model-compat-2.
aj: quick ask — if we need to reroute, do we want to use the canary fallback or full region fallback? canary first imo.
sam: canary is fine for latency-only, if errors escalate switch to region fallback. keep traffic logs (`/ops/traffic`) open.
maria: status update: kvcache miss-rate 62% for shard-7, model-alpha queue depth 18 -> prewarming now. running: ```bash
./tools/kvcache_preheat --shards 7 --concurrency 6
```
lia: adding runbook links: kvcache runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/kvcache-thrash ; routing fallback play: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/routing-fallbacks ; incident triage checklist: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/incident-triage-short
ops-bot: action logged: kvcache_preheat job started (job_id: j-9042). ETA ~90s.
maria: prewarm complete. miss-rate down to 18%, p99 latency dropping from 980ms -> 240ms. marking PAGER-3142 as mitigated unless we see regressions.
aj: confirmed p99 trending down. I'm standing by to take handover. send me the succession token and any sticky alerts at 21:40.
maria: leaving note for takeover: - open items: none critical; keep an eye on shard-7 for 1hr - escalation: if p99 > 800ms for >5min, trigger full region fallback and notify on-call-sre - contact list: sam (kv lead), lia (routing), aj (next primary)
sam: copied. one more: if prewarm didn't hit, there's a known infra race in kvcache-healthcheck v2 — rollback to v1 healthcheck until we patch. patch PR queued #4321.
maria: thanks. final: @aj i'll DM the succession secret at 21:45 and post a brief confirm here once you accept. :thumbsup:
aj: got it, will confirm. thanks team.
incident-bot: PAGER-3142 status changed: mitigated by kvcache prewarm (maria). archived at 2025-09-22T18:07:42Z.
lia: leaving a short cheat-sheet for future quick remeds: - kvcache: prewarm -> `kvcache_preheat` - model oom: pin quantized variant - latency burst: region fallback -> set route weight to fallback variant 100% - how to page infra: /ops/pager escalate infra-team (use template 'prod-latency-critical')
maria: handover done. signoff: maria -> aj at 21:50 local. stay safe folks. :wave:
